contexts.text: The servant told Isaac... () = perception from the Divine Natural... for perception is as it were an internal telling.
Tell me, I pray you () = that it should be known.
We told him () = that thence was a perception.
That my name may be declared... () = that the Lord be acknowledged as the only God.
To tell in the ears () = that they may know and apperceive.
Moses told his father-in-law () = perception from truth Divine.
That ye may tell it to the generation following () = their permanence to eternity. AE 850:8.
